title: selaginella inaequalifolia var. perelegans
intro: Selaginella inaequalifolia var. perelegans, commonly known as the fern-like spikemoss, is a type of plant that belongs to the Selaginellaceae family and is native to certain regions in Mexico. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella inaequalifolia var. perelegans include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit sedative effects. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
